context: Insurance briefing: Yuki explains a plan to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civic/insurance explanation; institutional vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新しい保険につきまして、ご説明します。
lines.en: I'll explain about the new insurance.
lines.style: polite office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 以前のものと、どう違うのかね?
lines.en: How does it differ from the previous one?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm attentive inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 対象が、団体まで広がりました。
lines.en: The coverage now extends to groups.
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 料金は、以前より高いのかね?
lines.en: Is the fee higher than before?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいえ、以下の通り、据え置きです。
lines.en: No — as below, it stays the same.
lines.style: reassuring office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 団体での加入も、可能なのかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、団体につきましても、対応します。
lines.en: Yes, we accommodate groups as well.
lines.style: polite office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よく分かった。資料を残しておいてくれ。
lines.en: Understood well. Leave the materials with me.
lines.style: satisfied boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
